note: Links and metadata only. No IELTS test content (passages, questions, audio, answer keys) is stored in this repo: all material is (c) the IELTS Partners / Cambridge University Press & Assessment and licensed for personal, non-commercial use on their own sites. Fluent365 links out; learners record raw scores/bands in the app. These are official SAMPLE / familiarisation materials, not released live exam papers. British Council (takeielts.britishcouncil.org), IELTS Ready and Road to IELTS pages could not be verified from the research environment (bot-blocked / unclear) and are omitted; see docs/research/IELTS_OFFICIAL_MATERIALS.md. 'minutes' and 'questions' are null where the provider gives none (single-task extracts); familiarisation tests are untimed in the player, minutes shown are real-test timings.
